title: Meme nova Paintings
description: new cool paintings.This resource pack for minecraft add new paintings with meme.Resource pack created with Nova skins
body: Welcome to Meme nova Paintings , an epic resource pack for Minecraft that flips your world’s art upside down—in the best possible way. This pack replaces paintings with modern internet memes, turning classic decor into a playground of humor, pop culture, and unexpected punchlines. Say farewell to traditional landscapes and hello to memes that poke fun at the game itself.
